programme.desc: Amelia Island's own Caffeine & Octane car show,: Featuring $2,000 Wrek Racing Truck, David Patterson's favorite C&O cars, a plastic Citroen Mehari, and much more.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Generation Amelia
programme.desc: The Concours d'Elegance from Amelia Island: Featuring bomb-proof Conquest Knight XV, '69 Camaro Hagerty Fixer-Upper, and car-enthusiast John Oates.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Delta Wing Racer with a Vengeance
programme.desc: State-of-the-art engineering and passion projects take center stage on this edition of Caffeine & Octane. The revolutionary Delta Wing Racer turns on hot lap after hot lap at Road Atlanta, and driver Katherine Legge offers insight on how “less is more” when it comes to power to weight ratios; the dark world of a graffiti artist paints a picture of a car called Vengeance while the hosts share the eclectic hybrids of machines that make it to Caffeine and Octane with Vengance’s creator Totem.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Henry Ford III & Counterfeit Cars
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. Even after 12 hours of racing at the Petit Le Mans endurance race, Henry Ford III, the great grandson of Henry Ford the industrial magnate and current member of Ford’s Board of Directors, showed up to take in the sights, address the crowds, and sign a one of a kind Ford Shelby GT350R. The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Go Fast Collections
programme.desc: Rickey and Bryan race outside of their comfort zones, each competing to find the raddest car collection. Rickey hangs out with classic racer, Ron Green, who shows him the ropes in the ultra light '83 Ralt RT5. Bryan visits a collection of 120 racing motorcycle owned by mechanic and racer Mike McConville. Mike takes Bryan motorcross racing in his backyard after showing off his high horsepowered car collection. Caffeine and Octane alongside Ron Green visit Atlanta's first Concours d'elegance to look at classic cars that have been perfectly maintained for decades.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - The Wrap on the Most Beautiful Cars
programme.desc: Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Panoz Racing & Chasing Chevys
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Retrofitting a Psycho Mercury
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Beetles, Bugs, and Buses, Oh My!
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Big Tigger v. Monster Muscle
programme.desc: Rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6–time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Dust, Bugs and More
programme.desc: Nick Rutter shows you how to remove bugs, polish exhaust tips and safetly remove dust

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Coating Your Car
programme.desc: Nick Rutter shows you the process of applying a coating from claying, polishing, and maintenance

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Race Ya!
programme.desc: When Kevin brings a punch-packing Dodge Charger into the garage, Willie gets an idea for a fast project of his own.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Daytona Turkey Run
programme.desc: Willie B spends a weekend at one of the biggest car events of the year, where a special project is being built right in the middle of all the madness.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Chevelle Part 1: Transmission Conversion
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie B take a 1970 Chevelle from an automatic to a manual transmission, outfitting the new engine along the way.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Chevelle Part 2: New Interior
programme.desc: Everyone knows that with a classic beauty, it’s really what’s on the inside that counts. Willie B and Kevin finish up a 1970 Chevelle project with some much-needed attention to the interior.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - On-and-Offroad Jeep
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie beef up the suspension on a 2014 Jeep JK to transform it from a daily driver into a weekend off-roading vehicle.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Duramax Diesel: Common Problems
programme.desc: A good diesel truck is indispensable on the jobsite, but Duramax diesels are known to have a few common problems. Kevin and Willie B show us what they are and how to fix them to keep your fleet complete.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Meaner Mustang
programme.desc: Nice cars finish last. Willie B and Kevin turn a mellow 2002 Mustang GT into a mean, lean, power machine with a few performance upgrades.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - A Tale of Two Trucks
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie diagnose a noise issue on a high-mileage F-150. Meanwhile, a battered old pickup shows up in the garage in need of serious repairs.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - AAR You Ready for This?
programme.desc: The team tears down Mike Hill's '70 Superbird and finishes up final touches on Chris Driscoll's '70 AAR Cuda. Daren confronts Mark about stealing parts from his car and Mark gets a rematch on Chris Driscoll's race track.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Go for It!
programme.desc: Holly asks Mark if she can work on cars. Mark Cain from Bad Boy Blasters brings the crew a huge gift. The '70 Barracuda Convertible is torn down and sent to the dipper, progress is made on the '70 Sunroof Challenger and Mark gets a surprise from one of his favorite actors.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Get Your Hands Dirty
programme.desc: Mark installs the hood decal on the '70 Sunroof Challenger, Holly helps Josh disassemble the Barracuda suspension, Mark and Daren work on the 440 engine for the Challenger, and the team assembles one of the rarest Mopar options, the sunroof for the '70 Challenger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - W-O-M-A-N, Mark Woman
programme.desc: The team rushes to ready the '69 Dodge Daytona for Tom Partridge and his family's visit. The guys settle a leadership dispute the old fashioned way, the Graveyard Carz van gets a face lift, and Daren retaliates when Mark won't let him sign for deliveries.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Pop Secrets
programme.desc: Holly helps Mark on the '70 Challenger, Daren annoys everyone with his popcorn and causes Mark to damage a very rare car. Tony D'Agostino, from Tony's Mopar Parts, visits and lends a hand on the '70 sunroof Challenger. Mark lets Holly in on the big secret and Daren reveals a secret of his own.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Let the Sunshine In
programme.desc: Mark gets a portable showroom, the '70 Hemi Charger is dissembled and the team finishes the 1970 Sunroof Challenger. Mark finally reveals his big secret project to the Graveyard Carz team and Royal makes a video tribute to the Sunroof Challenger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - The Royal Treatment
programme.desc: Mark and the ghouls build out the 440 Super Commando engine for their '70 Plymouth Superbird and install the suspension for the '69 Daytona Charger. Daren finally has enough of Mark's foolishness.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - The Grand Torino
programme.desc: Body man Derrick becomes an official Graveyard Carz crew member and assists in the disassembly of the rare '67 Plymouth Hemi GTX Convertible. Josh and Daren play "the game" with Mark.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - The Waltons
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghoulz get a massive sheet-metal order from AMD for their '70 Plymouth Superbird. Meanwhile, the owners of the '72 Charger visit and talk about what made their car so special. Daren gets the offer of a lifetime on his '70 Challenger R/T.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - It's the Great Pumpkin, Goldberg!
programme.desc: It's a Moparween at Graveyard Carz! Just when things couldn't get crazier, Bill Goldberg shows up to go over his '68 GTX Convertible and knock some sense into the guys. He can handle the NFL and the WCW, but can he hold his own at GYC?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Daytona Reborn Pt. 1
programme.desc: Mark is behind on his promise to get Tom Partidge's '69 Daytona Charger finished by the end of the month. The crew kicks into high gear to get Tom's Daytona looking great and out the door.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Daytona Reborn Pt. 2
programme.desc: Mark is behind on his promise to get Tom Partridge's '69 Daytona Charger finished by the end of the month. The crew bands together to do whatever is necessary to fulfill Mark's promise to the owner and bring it back to life.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Top 10 Mopar Muscle Moments
programme.desc: The Ghoulz pay tribute to their favorite moments over the previous seasons. This special episode looks back over seasons 1-3 of Graveyard Carz, but includes all new interviews to highlight some previously unrevealed details.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - The Elephant in the Room
programme.desc: A 1970 Dodge Charger engine is restored in this Special episode.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Daren and Royal Go Topless
programme.desc: A rare 1970 Charger and a 1970 Barracuda 383 are featured.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - General Disassemble Lee
programme.desc: A 1968 Charger, a 1970 Challenger R/T, and a 1969 Charger are featured.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Mo Money Mo Challengers
programme.desc: A 1972 Dodge Charger is restored.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Drive a Mile in My Shoes
programme.desc: A 1969 Road Runner is featured.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz - Top Banana Charge
programme.desc: Work on a 1972 Dodge Charger is continued.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Car Care Accessories
programme.desc: Nick Rutter shows you the most helpful and handy car care accessories

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Matte Finishes
programme.desc: Nick Rutter shows you the how to clean and coat your matte finish

programme.title: Truck U - UTV Chase Truck
programme.desc: The guys outfit a UTV Chase Truck to make sure their Race UTV can make it to the finish line.

programme.title: Truck U - Patina C-10
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno work on a vintage C-10 with a few modern conveniences.

programme.title: Truck U - Modern Scrambler
programme.desc: Don’t miss this episode of Truck U, when Matt and Bruno transform a modern Jeep LJ into a vintage Cj-8 scrambler.

programme.title: Truck U - Turbo Rebuild
programme.desc: See what it takes to rebuild a Turbo in a 7.3L Diesel on this episode of Truck U.

programme.title: Truck U - Pick-Up the Pieces
programme.desc: Like many projects, this 1954 Chevy 3100 restoration has stalled. So, we’re going to help this owner pickup the pieces on this project by installing a new 350 engine, completely overhaul the front end, and bolt-on new bumpers. After were done, this truck will be ready to get wired and fired.

programme.title: Truck U - Billie Hop
programme.desc: Sometimes Bruno will do a favor for a fellow Race Car Driver friend. That’s why Top Fuel driver Clay Millican’s old Dodge Cummins is in the shop. Like everything Clay drives, this truck is tortured and has broke a few things. Matt and Bruno get to play pit today on Truck U.

programme.title: Truck U - Off-Road Toyota
programme.desc: Bruno and Matt have earned some vacation time, but before they get to take a break they need to finish work on the 2012 Toyota Tacoma 4wd. The guys transform a Toyota into a Expedition vehicle that can light up any path in its way.

programme.title: Truck U - Trail Rocker
programme.desc: It’s time for the ultimate axle reconstructive surgery.We install brand new Dana 44 axles on a 2008 Jeep Jk 4 wheel drive.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - THE CORVETTE
programme.desc: For Rick Hendrick, the Corvette inspired his first car purchase, which ultimately led to the creation of his car dealership empire and motorsports teams. Mr. H, as he goes by, gives us a rare look inside of his personal Corvette collection and takes us to General Motors World Headquarters to talk with GM Vice President of Global Design, Ed Welburn, about how this iconic car came about. Country superstar Brad Paisley makes a cameo appearance to talk about his prized ‘Vette and the influence of cars on his music.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - ELVIS VAULT
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BAND OF BROTHERS
programme.desc: This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BREAK UP TO MAKEUP
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BATTLE FOR ROME
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - SECRETS OF GM
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - FIRST MUSTANG
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - FORGOTTEN FIBERGLASS
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Exotic Car Hunter
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Andruw Jones' Super Jeep
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Jekyll and Hide
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Big Yellow Taxi
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Peach State Challengers
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Lambo Racer
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Boston's (Un)Common Collection
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - C&O at the Beach
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: AmeriCarna - DISCOVERIES IN JERSEY
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - MOVIE CARS
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - HOT ROD HOLY GRAIL
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - CORVETTE SINK HOLE
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - ROAR AT THE SHORE
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Mitsubishi Outlander Plug-In Hybrid, the world's first hybrid SUV with two electric motors and a 2-liter combustion engine. Also: the Chevrolet Silverado, an American full-size pickup with a V8 and an average consumption of at least 15 liters.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Bentley EXP 9F and Jaguar C-X17 are concept cars the two manufacturers presented before they started making their own luxury SUVs. Also: how did Toyota, Nissan or Subaru see the future of the SUV? And: Mercedes-Benz' Unimog concept car.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The SUVs Nissan X-Trail and BMW X4 aren't typical offroaders. We witnessed the presentation of the new X-Trail model and BMW's premiere of their X4. Also: the Steinbeißer Trophy, where unusual offroad vehicles take part in a demanding rally.

programme.title: BMW M3
programme.desc: In the late 80s BMW brought a car onto the market which carried true racing genes. Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. Whenever its name is mentioned, car fans feel goosebumps - even today: the BMW M3.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: With the Bentley Bentayga, the traditional British brand is entering the fastest growing market segment. This world's first luxury SUV is a conglomerate of superlatives on wheels.

programme.title: Volvo XC60
programme.desc: The Swedish landscape is characterized by mountains, forests and lonely roads. Ideal for this off-roader. The Volvo XC60 scores with many safety features and a cool appearance.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: With the M3, BMW brought race car technology to the road. In addition: 120 years of Mercedes-Benz motorsports history. And: turbo power in the DTM. The Ford Sierra RS Cosworth taught its racing competition the meaning of fear.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The year 1964 marked Opel's foray into the upper class market. The company presented its KAD series with the Kapitän, Admiral and Diplomat models, combining US design with solid German technology.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The BMW 507 Roadster was cherished by superstars like Elvis Presley. Today, the 150 HP sports car from 1955 is one of the most valuable classics of all time. Also: following the footsteps of the iconic Porsche brand in a 356 Cabrio.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Cars like the Ford GT 40, the Jaguar D-Type or the Mercedes 300 SL wrote history on the race track and now break records at auctions. A sumptuously restored 300 SL will start at the most famous classic car rally in the world, the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: We followed the restoration of the unique Bayer K67 research vehicle, the first all-plastic car in the world, developed in 1967 by the pharmaceutical giant Bayer.

programme.title: Lancia Stratos HF
programme.desc: The Lancia Stratos with Ferrari power, the rally icon of the 1970s.

programme.title: BMW 328 Schlüter
programme.desc: If a car arrives in a trailer, its value is usually very high. The original BMW 328 Schlüter is already rare and expensive. But this model is a reconstruction and it is absolutely unique.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Audi set new standards with their RS5 Coupe. Also: the Erzberg Rodeo is one of the toughest enduro races in the world. We show highlights from the 2012 event. And: the Suzuki Kizashi 4x4 and the Mercedes-Benz GL.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Ariel Atom is a street-legal sports car that provides ultimate acceleration and maximum cornering speed. Also: the third-generation Audi A3 on the roads of Mallorca. And: the Mini John Cooper Works Roadster and the fifth-generation Chevrolet Camaro.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: With the GT86, Toyota want to create a sports car that builds upon the glory days of the company's success model Celica. Also: Audi TT RS vs. Mercedes-AMG SLK 55. And: the Techart GT Street R, a souped-up Porsche 911 Turbo.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Peugeot introduced an updated version of their 208 success model, and there is also a rally version named R2. Also: how far can to go in a Volkswagen Polo BlueGT? And: the Freestyle Festival Swatch Free4Style.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Nissan's and Datsun's Z model range of cars is for the Japanese what the Porsche 911 is for Germans. Also: the Porsche Cup 2011 at Nürburgring. And: Audi A7 vs. Mercedes-Benz CLS 350.

programme.title: Lamborghini Huracan by O.CT
programme.desc: A lot of power thanks to a compressor. This optimized O.CT Lamborghini Huracán delivers over 800 horse power to get the blood flowing.

programme.title: Rimac Concept One
programme.desc: The futuristically designed Rimac Concept One is one of the fastest, most powerful and expensive electric cars in the world, it does not adhere to convention.

programme.title: Jaguar XJR
programme.desc: The highlight of the XJR lies beneath the hood: all of Jaguar's top models are equipped with the 5-liter V8 compressor engine that delivers 550 HP in this sports sedan.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Since its introduction in 1983 the Opel Combo has been very successful with both craftspeople and families alike. We took a look at the updated version. Also: with the XC40, Volvo introduced a new mobility concept called Care by Volvo.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Porsche packed a lot of power into the Panamera. We took their Sport Turismo model to the Formula One track in Bahrain. In addition: BMW redesigned their 530i Touring 4-cylinder station wagon. And: an trip to Cologne in the Volvo V60.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Beside SUVs, compact and city cars are on the rise. For many people, a Kia Picanto is enough to satisfy their mobility needs. In addition: the Audi A1 offers certain features of the luxury class, but at a much higher price. And: the agile Kia Ceed GT.

programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10
programme.desc: The Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 has its origins in the Japanese army. Its shape won’t win any beauty contests or achieve the best results in the wind tunnel, but this is not really the point with an SUV like this.

programme.title: Cadillac CTS-V
programme.desc: Those who don’t know about it will only see a dignified sedan but under the hood hides the 649 horse power 6.2 liter V8 supercharged engine of the Corvette Z06. This car is a good alternative to the Audi RS6, BMW M5 and Mercedes E63 AMG.

programme.desc: The Porsche 911 Targa with its lightweight construction is an iconic car. Also: the Lotus Seven Twin Cam SS is more pf a race than a road car. And: the 1930 Bentley Blower and the dainty British roadster, the Sunbeam Tiger.

programme.title: Classic Ride

programme.desc: The 1947 Triumph 1800 Roadster provides space for 5 fresh air fans. Also: Le Jog, the toughest classic car rally in Europe. A German women's team takes on the challenge in their VW Iltis. And: a charming oldie, the 1919 Wolseley Stellite.

programme.desc: We took a look at three very different Harley-Davidson models. The versatile Switchback Dyna, the motorized wheelie bike Sportster 72, and the bad-boy motorcycle Softail Slim.

programme.title: KTM 990 Adventure
programme.desc: It's very big and mostly comes in orange: the KTM 990 Adventure. Over rough terrain it's often driven standing up. Today, the 990 is considered the off-road specialist among travel Enduros.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, the Facel Vega Facellia was designed to compete with Porsche and Alfa Romeo and open a new market segment for the fledgling French luxury car company.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: At the Essen Motor Show over 500 exhibitors present the latest highlights from the car tuning scene. Everything can be found here, from accessories available to everyone to handmade sports cars and top class tuning.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Abt Sportsline stands for car tuning at the highest level. Abt's slogan isn't 'from the race track to the road ' for nothing. Also: the Rohte VW Golf R20. And: the BMW Art Car.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: We visited Brabus, the largest independent automobile tuner where you can find more than 9,000 HP in one place. Also: MTM's Audi RS6 Clubsport.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Berlin-based company TH Automobiles equips Volkswagen vans with Porsche engines, turning a T5 into one of the most dynamic large saloon cars in the world.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Conti Tuning Day is themed "Power Sedans" and we take a closer look at the cars on display. Plus: Swiss eccentric Ueli Anliker has built the most expensive Mercedes-AMG SLR in the world, the "Red Gold Dream".

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Gemballa specialises in refining Porsche models, but its portfolio also includes brands such as Ferrari. And: the car tuning company Irmscher turns the Chevrolet Camaro into the 'Irmscher Camaro i42'.

programme.title: Porsche 550 RS Spyder
programme.desc: Small, lightweight, agile and swift as an arrow. Historic image documents of the Porsche 550 RS Spyder.

programme.title: BMW 750i xDrive
programme.desc: The BMW 750i is the second most powerful car in the 7 series. It may be mercilessly overpowered for the daily commute to work, but thanks to this power the two-ton vehicle doesn't feel as heavy as it actually is.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Robust, honest, simple, the Land Rover is the bedrock of all off-road vehicles. Built in 1948 as a simple car for British farmers, the vehicle quickly became an export hit. Today, the Land Rover is at home all over the world.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Vive la différence: the cars of Renault are always unusual in design, exceptional in their driving comfort and often avant-gardistic. Renault writes history with the Dauphine, R4, R5 and R16 models.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: From the very beginning, Citroën celebrated the joy of extravagance. Already the Traction Avant from the 1950s is a milestone in automotive history and the 2CV is one of the most unusual and charming small cars ever built.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Golf is nothing more but a reasonable car - there's nothing really exciting about it, but still it's a mega-seller. The Golf is compatible with the masses and dominates the compact car class since its market introduction.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Be it the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the Monte Carlo Rally or Formula 1: Porsche won it all at least once. Even the first prototype was a race winner, and the successes of the Spyder in the Carrera Panamericana or the Targa Florio are unforgettable.

programme.title: Creme 21 Youngtimer Rally 2019
programme.desc: Welcome to the 80s, the period in time in which there were only three skin creams and three television programs on air and Tuesday night was Dallas night. Car enthusiasts can feel like they’re back in those times once a year at the Creme 21 classic car rally.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: New Zealand Jetsprint Championship
programme.desc: Group A action intensifies in Round 2 at Shelter View as Matt Hareb, Ollie Silverton and Rasmussen compete for their spot on the podium. Close times and consistent runs underline this growing rivalry.

programme.title: New Zealand Jetsprint Championship
programme.desc: Round 2 at Shelter View delivers a Superboat showdown as Reuben Hoeksema and Sam Newdick are going head to head again. Tight times, huge speed and redemption after Round 1 create a dramatic highlight in Whanganui.

programme.title: Icelandic Formula Offroad
programme.desc: Round two of the Icelandic Formula Off-Road championship takes place in Stangarhylur. The drivers return to the previous year's familiar hills, where they have to draw on all their experience in order to master the challenging terrain.

programme.title: Icelandic Formula Offroad
programme.desc: Round 3 of the Icelandic Formula Off-Road in Egilsstaðir begins with tracks one to three. Steep hills, tight gates and technical terrain push drivers to the limit, as precision and power are key in one of the toughest events of the season.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The new BMW One M Coupe from former race car driver Ralf Kelleners: the KS1 RS. Also: Toyota present their TS 030 hybrid at the 24-hours race of Le Mans. And: Subaru's XV crossover stands out from the company's model range.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The 'little' Mercedes-Benz S250 with a four-cylinder engine needs so little fuel that one could call this car a piggybank. Also: the power packages Nissan 370 Z and Wiesmann GT MF5. And: the ADAC Eco Test.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The new Porsche Boxter, a real open-top sports car. Also: Volkswagen presents the new Passat Alltrack, a real allrounder. And: Fiat's successful Panda model in its third generation version.

programme.title: Mercedes Sprinter, 2018
programme.desc: The Mercedes Sprinter belongs to the class of commercial vehicles. The light transporter is the dream for every tradesman. The third generation Sprinter is sleeker, more modern and more variable than ever.

programme.title: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: A Jaguar that is able to terrify the world alone with its roar. This Jaguar F-Type R tuned by Arden is a real bad boy. Already in the series production configuration, the F-Type R Coupe is a dream car that can really bite but this Jaguar which has been upgraded from Arden, now calls itself "AJ23“ and is more powerful, louder and more aggressive than any of his brothers.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: In 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini set himself the goal to build the best sports cars in the world, a bold move, being located only a few kilometers from Ferrari.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: After the Second World War, following in his father's footsteps who had been responsible for the development of the classic Volkswagen, Ferry Porsche laid the foundation for the brand's sports car models like the 356 and later the Porsche 911.

programme.title: Motorheads

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 59 Amsterdam
programme.desc: GLORY Kickboxing’s Summer of GLORY concluded with a massive event from the Johan Cruijff Arena in Amsterdam. In the night’s headliner, heavyweight champion Rico Verhoeven took on Brazilian challenger Guto Inocente. Verhoeven had defended his belt seven straight times since capturing the title in 2014. His winning streak inside the GLORY ring stood at 16. Inocente looked to dethrone the world’s top-ranked heavyweight riding the momentum of wins over Benjamin Adegbuyi, D’Angelo Marshall and Hesdy Gerges. Gold was also on the line in the co-main event, as longtime featherweight titleholder Robin van Roosmalen rematched interim champion Petchpanomrung Kiatmookao. The pair met previously at GLORY 41 — also in van Roosmalen’s home country of Holland — with the Dutchman taking home a controversial, majority-decision victory.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 62 Rotterdam
programme.desc: GLORY is bringing out the heavy hitters for their final show of 2018, as an eight-man heavyweight tournament has been set for Rotterdam. Headlined by former heavyweight contender tournament winner Benjamin Adegbuyi and Jamal Ben Saddik as the top two seed, the winner will go on to win $100,000 for making it through the eight-man, three-round affair.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 82 Bonn
programme.desc: The event will be headlined by an exhilarating heavyweight matchup between No. 1 ranked contender Antonio Plazibat and No. 10 ranked contender Raul Catinas. Co-headlining the event is a Welterweight Title Bout between Alim Nabiyev and Endy Semeleer. Also featured on the card, MMA veteran Joilton Lutterbach will make his GLORY debut against fellow debutant Mark Trijsburg in a welterweight bout. Top-five lightweight contender Itay Gershon will make his return to the GLORY ring against promotional newcomer Cihad Akipa. The card will also mark the return of perennial heavyweight contender Jahfarr Wilnis, who will be making his first appearance on the GLORY stage since 2019. He will meet promotional newcomer Michal Blawdziewicz.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 83 Essen
programme.desc: Headlining the event is a Light Heavyweight Title Fight between current Champion Sergej Maslobojev and top ranked contender Donegi Abena. A Middleweight Title Bout between Champion Donovan Wisse and current number one contender Cesar Almeida will serve as the event’s co-headliner. Also featured on the card is a middleweight bout between top-five contenders Serkan Ozcaglayan and Sergej Braun. Plus, perennial lightweight contender Guerric Billet will meet Cihad Akipa. GLORY 83 will also mark the promotional debuts for both Uku Jurjendal and Nabil Khachab, who will square off against each other in a heavyweight bout. Additionally, rising featherweight contender Ahmad Chikh Mousa will look to improve his GLORY record to 3-0 in a bout against Berjan Peposhi.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 84 Rotterdam

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 85 Rotterdam
programme.desc: GLORY 85 will feature the four-man heavyweight tournament featuring two-time tournament finalist Jahfarr Wilnis (33-13-1, 8 KO), Heavyweight newcomer Murat Aygun (33-3-0), Nigerian giant Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (22-2-1), and ‘The Iron Bull’ Enver Sljivar (40-6, 23 KO). programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 86 Germany
programme.desc: In the main event, featherweight champ Petch (168-39-3, 27 KO) looks to defend his crown for the sixth time when he welcomes the challenge of local hero Ahmad Chikh Mousa (58-8-1, 28 KO). The co-main event will see a crucial fight between Romania’s Benjamin Adegbuyi (35-8, 20 KO) and Sofian Laïdouni (35-2-1, 17 KO) of France that will decide who will qualify for the GLORY Heavyweight Grand Prix in December.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - COLLISION 5
programme.desc: The interim-GLORY Heavyweight Title will be up for grabs as top ranked heavyweight contender Antonio Plazibat (22-4, 16 KO) collides with the number two ranked Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (24-2-1, 12 KO) in the main event. These teammates will have to put their friendship aside for one night and go head-to-head for GLORY gold. Also on the card are title fights in the Middleweight, Welterweight and Light Heavyweight divisions.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 87 Rotterdam

The four participants are Dutch giant Martin Terpstra (21-5, 11 KO), former light heavyweight title contender Mohamed Amine (29-5, 16 KO), the explosive Bahram Rajabzadeh (62-1, 56 KO), and the bruising power puncher Uku Jürjendal (18-7, 14 KO). A huge international title fight will feature in the co-main event as Tyjani Beztati (24-4, 9 KO) will put his GLORY lightweight championship on the line against Japanese star Kaito Ono (51-6-1, 22 KO).

programme.desc: A huge title fight rematch will take place in the main event as rivals Tiffany ‘Time Bomb’ van Soest (24-6-2, 9 KO) and Sarah Moussaddak (8-3, 1 KO) lock horns once again. The rest of the card is stacked with some exciting names and thrilling fights. French Algerian Nordine Mahieddine (27-15, 12 KO) collides with France’s Abderahmane Coulibaly (58-20-1, 25 KO) in a big heavyweight contest, Germany’s Denis Wosik (37-8-1, 9 KO) meets the super popular Albanian Berjan Peposhi (27-3, 16 KO), former GLORY title challenger Karim Ghajji (103-17-1, 53 KO) returns and squares-off against Serbia’s Nikola Todorovic (26-3, 14 KO), and Iliass Hammouche (32-6, 7 KO) will finally make his much anticipated debut against Germany’s Florian Kroger (19-9, 6 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY 89 Bulgaria
programme.desc: Badr Hari will go head-to-head with Estonia’s Uku Jürjendal in a GLORY Grand Prix Qualifier. Middleweight Champ Petchpanomrung will defend his belt against newcomer David Meija. Bulgarias own, Stoyan Koprivlenski, will face off with Romanian Sorin Caliniuc. Also fighting is Heavyweight Levi Rigters and Luis Tavares makes his return.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing - GLORY COLLISION 6
programme.desc: The undisputed heavyweight king of kickboxing will be decided in the main event as long reigning champion Rico Verhoeven (60-10, 20 KO) goes up against arguably his most dangerous opponent to date in interim-heavyweight champ Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (25-2-1, 13 KO). Middleweight champ Donovan Wisse (19-1, 10 KO) puts his title on the line against number one contender Michael Boapeah (16-3-1, 7 KO). Wisse has looked unstoppable so far during his title run but now he faces an in-form Michael Boapeah who holds a win over the only man to beat Wisse. The welterweight division sees top ranked stars go head-to-head as Hamicha (40-2, 30 KO) takes on Diaguely Camara (24-4-1, 10 KO) and Jay Overmeer (29-5, 15 KO) meets Chico Kwasi (41-5, 22 KO). It’s also an important evening at middleweight with Serkan Ozcaglayan (45-8, 36 KO) colliding with Ulric Bokeme (31-4, 17 KO) and the recently debuted Iliass Hammouche (33-6, 7 KO) facing Ivan Galaz (58-10-1, 15 KO). A huge featherweight match-up between the number one ranked Abraham Vidales (15-2, 12 KO) and number two ranked Ahmad Chikh Mousa (58-8-1, 28 KO) plus an exciting light heavyweight bout between Ibrahim El Bouni (41-8-1, 22 KO) and Stefan Latescu (16-2, 7 KO) will round out the main card.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 393 - Centurion FC 19 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championships 19 part 1 from Rio de Janeiro. First up Darlan Santos takes on Junior "The Golden Boy" Dias in an intense matchup with contrasting styles. In a dynamic clash, Helio "Big Boy" Nunes, known for his aggressive style and strong finishing abilities, takes on Rafael Silva, who will rely on his stand-up striking skills in a dynamic clash. Expect an intense, high-energy bout between two rising Brazilian fighter as Milson Castro Barao faces William Lima Malvadeza in the first Grand Prix semi-final fight. In the Grand Prix semi-final 2 Walber Dos Anjos Timoteo faces Paulo Henrique Laia in what should be a well-rounded and technical fight followed by the Grand Prix final match.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 396 - Centurion FC 19 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championships 19 part 2 from Rio de Janeiro. In this Boxing Extreme matchup Paulo Pizzo faces Anderson Dos Santos Berinja in a clash of striking versus grappling and two well rounded fighters take to the cage next as Mauricio Faccao faces Marcos Babuino. In an what's expected to be an action packed MMA match, Yury Neles Seu Jorge looks to end the match early with a KO against Luciano "Lulu" Oliveira.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 397 - Shamrock FC 356
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock Fighting Championship 356 from St. Louis, Missouri. Starting off with a kickboxing match, Tommy Brown faces Sean Coray while Jacob Mattson steps into the cage with Derek Cullison. In another kickboxing event Sam Eldridge challenges Nik Green. Also in this episode, UFC and Strikeforce veteran Lucas Lopes takes his last walk inside the cage as he faces Matt Tinker. In the main event watch as rising star Jackson McVey faces veteran Bare Knuckle Boxer Jaquis Williams

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 398 - Red Owl BoxFest XI
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl BoxFest XI from Houston, Texas. In tonights episode Giovanni Marquez trades punches with Thomas Guillemette and in the main event Quinton Randall and Janelson Figueroa Bocachica take to the ring with the WBA Continental USA Welterweight Title on the line.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 399 - BKB 37 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 37 part 1 from London. Starting off this three part bare knuckle series, Jack "The Athenean" McLean faces Hayden Sherriff in a London versus Manchester matchup. Watch as Reece Murray and Liam Wilson take to the ring and Sean McPike looks to take out Mark Handley. In a female bout Sweden's Mathilda Wilson meets challenger Sadie Reffell from peterborough making her BKB debut.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 400 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 37 part 2
programme.desc: Marley Churcher v Tom Stokes, Luke Smith v Nathan Massey, Aaron McCallum v Corey Healey

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 401 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 37 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 37 part 3 from London. First up in a British featherweight title clash, defending champ Rolando Dy steps into the cage with Martin Reffell and in the co-main event for the World heavyweight Title, challenger Richie Leak takes on reighing chanpionship Dan Podmore. In the main event, watch defending champ, Jimmy Sweeney as he faces James Connelly, world lightweight champion.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 402 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 1 from Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features an 8 man tournament in the cruiserweight division. The champion will face the challenger in the ISKA world cruiserweight championship. Fighting in the quarter finals are Alessio Sarbu vs Sebastian Lutaniuc, Becali Bodescu vs Marius Rotaru, Costi Mocany vs Danut Hurduc and Alex Virlan vs Ionut Busuioc.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 403 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 2 from Targu Jiu, Romania. Continuining the 8 man tournament in the crusierweight division, this episode features the semi-finals. In a SuperFight open weight division bout Vajtan Shanava, Spanish champion for three consecutive years, steps into the ring with Claudiu "The Prince" Badoi, Romanian favorite with a record of 62 wins and 31 by KO.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 404 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 3 from Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features the 8 man tournament final for the DFS crusierweight belt. But first, stepping into the ring are Alexandros Chrysochoidis and Bogdan Nastase with 55 victories, face off in a Superfight in the light heavyweight division. Next up two champions, Calin Petrisor, the defending ISKA champion and Valentin Mavrodin the defending DFS champion take to the ring for a title fight with the ISKA and DFS belt unificaiton on the line in the middleweight division.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 491 - Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor in Targu Jiu, Romania. The winners of each of these quarter finals will move to the next round in the championship tournament.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 399 - BKB 37 part 1

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 402 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 1 from Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features an 8 man tournament in the cruiserweight division. programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 403 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 2 from Targu Jiu, Romania. In a SuperFight open weight division bout Vajtan Shanava, Spanish champion for three consecutive years, steps into the ring with Claudiu "The Prince" Badoi, Romanian favorite with a record of 62 wins and 31 by KO.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 404 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 3 from Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features the 8 man tournament final for the DFS crusierweight belt. programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 491 - Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor in Targu Jiu, Romania. programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 393 - Centurion FC 19 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championships 19 part 1 from Rio de Janeiro. First up Darlan Santos takes on Junior "The Golden Boy" Dias in an intense matchup with contrasting styles. In a dynamic clash, Helio "Big Boy" Nunes, known for his aggressive style and strong finishing abilities, takes on Rafael Silva, who will rely on his stand-up striking skills in a dynamic clash. Expect an intense, high-energy bout between two rising Brazilian fighter as Milson Castro Barao faces William Lima Malvadeza in the first Grand Prix semi-final fight. In the Grand Prix semi-final 2 Walber Dos Anjos Timoteo faces Paulo Henrique Laia in what should be a well-rounded and technical fight followed by the Grand Prix final match.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 396 - Centurion FC 19 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championships 19 part 2 from Rio de Janeiro. In this Boxing Extreme matchup Paulo Pizzo faces Anderson Dos Santos Berinja in a clash of striking versus grappling and two well rounded fighters take to the cage next as Mauricio Faccao faces Marcos Babuino. In an what's expected to be an action packed MMA match, Yury Neles Seu Jorge looks to end the match early with a KO against Luciano "Lulu" Oliveira.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 397 - Shamrock FC 356
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock Fighting Championship 356 from St. Louis, Missouri. Starting off with a kickboxing match, Tommy Brown faces Sean Coray while Jacob Mattson steps into the cage with Derek Cullison. In another kickboxing event Sam Eldridge challenges Nik Green. Also in this episode, UFC and Strikeforce veteran Lucas Lopes takes his last walk inside the cage as he faces Matt Tinker. In the main event watch as rising star Jackson McVey faces veteran Bare Knuckle Boxer Jaquis Williams

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 481 - Dream Boxing 14 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dream Boxing 14 part 1 from Riga, Latvia. First up Miks Berzins takes on Aleksandrs Sidorans for a heavyweight bout. In the ffinal match, Aleksis Volkovics, making his pro-debut, and Igor Trosins, both Latvian, take to the ring.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 482 - Dream Boxing 14 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dream Boxing 14 part 2 from Riga, Latvia. In the main event, Joel Mafauad from Argentina steps into the ring with Karen Chukhadzhian from Ukraine for a WBO and IBF international title match with two belts up for grabs.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 447 - Up Next Fighting 13 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 13 part 1 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. First up, striker Bryen Dao takes on brawler Ferrin Marcelin in the featherweight division and Aiden Ingram steps into the cage with Steve Mora in a bantamweight bout. Also on this card Carlos Figueroa looks to break Artem Afanasenko's undefeated streak. In the main event, Christopher "Taco" Padilla puts his lightweight title on the line when he faces his toughest opponent yet with five time UFC veteran Justin Janyes.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 451 - Up Next Fighting 13 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 13 part 2 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. Starting off in the bantamweight division, Jonathan Powell steps into the cage with veteran grappler Will Holguin. In a featherweight bout, striker Jonny O'Neill takes on wrestler Eudardo Zarate with the winner moving on to a title opportunity. Also watch as Adam Garcia and Zachary Kraschinsky take to the ring in a lightweight bout. With two titles on the line in the featured bout, the rising star UNF Featherweight title and the California State featherweight title in the rising stars division, Stone Lavelle and his opponient Sean Crenshaw battle it out for the two belts.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 448 - Shamrock FC 365
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 365 from Ameristar Hotel and Casio in Missouri. In the main event UFC veteran Dustin "Scrappy" Lampros takes on BJJ blackbelt Steven "Golden" Graham.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 444 - Fightbook Presents: The Butterfly Brawl part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents The Butterfly Brawl part 1 brought to you by Fightbook from the stunning backdrop of The Santa Monica Pier. This charity boxing event brings together elite fighters and the electric energy of the coast in support of the American Cancer Society. Also watch as undefeated Isaiah Carr faces the Philllipines' Daniel Lim. In the middleweight division Poland's Eryk Apresyan faces Terrell "The Sharpshooter" Adams.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 393 - Centurion FC 19 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championships 19 part 1 from Rio de Janeiro. First up Darlan Santos takes on Junior "The Golden Boy" Dias in an intense matchup with contrasting styles. In a dynamic clash, Helio "Big Boy" Nunes, known for his aggressive style and strong finishing abilities, takes on Rafael Silva, who will rely on his stand-up striking skills in a dynamic clash. Expect an intense, high-energy bout between two rising Brazilian fighter as Milson Castro Barao faces William Lima Malvadeza in the first Grand Prix semi-final fight. In the Grand Prix semi-final 2 Walber Dos Anjos Timoteo faces Paulo Henrique Laia in what should be a well-rounded and technical fight followed by the Grand Prix final match.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 396 - Centurion FC 19 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championships 19 part 2 from Rio de Janeiro. In this Boxing Extreme matchup Paulo Pizzo faces Anderson Dos Santos Berinja in a clash of striking versus grappling and two well rounded fighters take to the cage next as Mauricio Faccao faces Marcos Babuino. In an what's expected to be an action packed MMA match, Yury Neles Seu Jorge looks to end the match early with a KO against Luciano "Lulu" Oliveira.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 397 - Shamrock FC 356
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock Fighting Championship 356 from St. Louis, Missouri. Also in this episode, UFC and Strikeforce veteran Lucas Lopes takes his last walk inside the cage as he faces Matt Tinker. In the main event watch as rising star Jackson McVey faces veteran Bare Knuckle Boxer Jaquis Williams

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 398 - Red Owl BoxFest XI
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl BoxFest XI from Houston, Texas. programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 399 - BKB 37 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 37 part 1 from London. Starting off this three part bare knuckle series, Jack "The Athenean" McLean faces Hayden Sherriff in a London versus Manchester matchup. Watch as Reece Murray and Liam Wilson take to the ring and Sean McPike looks to take out Mark Handley. In a female bout Sweden's Mathilda Wilson meets challenger Sadie Reffell from peterborough making her BKB debut.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 400 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 37 part 2
programme.desc: Marley Churcher v Tom Stokes, Luke Smith v Nathan Massey, Aaron McCallum v Corey Healey

In the main event, watch defending champ, Jimmy Sweeney as he faces James Connelly, world lightweight champion.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 447 - Up Next Fighting 13 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 13 part 1 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. First up, striker Bryen Dao takes on brawler Ferrin Marcelin in the featherweight division and Aiden Ingram steps into the cage with Steve Mora in a bantamweight bout. Also on this card Carlos Figueroa looks to break Artem Afanasenko's undefeated streak. In the main event, Christopher "Taco" Padilla puts his lightweight title on the line when he faces his toughest opponent yet with five time UFC veteran Justin Janyes.

programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 13 part 2 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. In a featherweight bout, striker Jonny O'Neill takes on wrestler Eudardo Zarate with the winner moving on to a title opportunity. Also watch as Adam Garcia and Zachary Kraschinsky take to the ring in a lightweight bout. With two titles on the line in the featured bout, the rising star UNF Featherweight title and the California State featherweight title in the rising stars division, Stone Lavelle and his opponient Sean Crenshaw battle it out for the two belts.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 448 - Shamrock FC 365

In the main event UFC veteran Dustin "Scrappy" Lampros takes on BJJ blackbelt Steven "Golden" Graham.

programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents The Butterfly Brawl part 1 brought to you by Fightbook from the stunning backdrop of The Santa Monica Pier. This charity boxing event brings together elite fighters and the electric energy of the coast in support of the American Cancer Society. In this first episode Julio Tanori from Mexico steps into the ring after a two year haitus with the young Jason "Dynamite" Robledo from California. Also watch as undefeated Isaiah Carr faces the Philllipines' Daniel Lim. In the middleweight division Poland's Eryk Apresyan faces Terrell "The Sharpshooter" Adams.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 482 - Dream Boxing 14 part 2

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 447 - Up Next Fighting 13 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 13 part 1 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. First up, striker Bryen Dao takes on brawler Ferrin Marcelin in the featherweight division and Aiden Ingram steps into the cage with Steve Mora in a bantamweight bout. Also on this card Carlos Figueroa looks to break Artem Afanasenko's undefeated streak. In the main event, Christopher "Taco" Padilla puts his lightweight title on the line when he faces his toughest opponent yet with five time UFC veteran Justin Janyes.

programme.title: Distance Between Dreams
programme.desc: Pros take on Jaws, Hawaii’s legendary wave, made even bigger and wilder by historically big winter weather.

programme.title: 7 Miles of Paradise
programme.desc: The North Shore is a 7 Mile stretch of paradise like no other on Earth. Every year thousands of people flock to the North Shore of Oahu to see the world's best surfers ride arguably the world's best waves. Pro surfers have created their careers, made their livings and even become legends from surfing these shores. Pro surfer Anastasia Ashley will be your tour guide and take you to the places she loves, the places she went as a kid growing up there, and introduce you to the people that always made it feel like home. We will experience and understand why she loves the North Shore, and considers it '7 Miles of Paradise'

programme.title: The Essence of Surfing
programme.desc: The Essence of Surfing is a riveting surf documentary that gets to the heart of why surfing is the greatest sport in the world. Featuring surfers of all kinds, from the neighborhood grom to some of the greatest surfers to ever live, The Essence of Surfing uncovers what it is about this awesome sport that makes it a necessary part of each of their lives. Shot in the world's most beautiful locations by top notch Cinematographers Erik Ippel and Mike Prickett, this film is sure to hook and inspire anyone looking to get wet and catch some waves.

programme.title: Surfing Is Art
programme.desc: Dive into the ultimate surf adventure with surfing legends riding epic waves in Hawaii, California, & Mexico.

programme.title: Surfing Golden California
programme.desc: Kelly Slater, Tom Curren, John John Florence and more explore the essence of California's surfing scene.

programme.title: No Contest: Off Tour
programme.desc: Florida’s long coast, heavy waves, and champ pedigree make it a best-kept surfing secret.

programme.title: No Contest: Off Tour
programme.desc: Explore Honolulu’s pristine waves, culture, community, and deep Hawaiian heritage.

programme.title: No Contest: Off Tour
programme.desc: Japan blends tradition, technology, and quality swell to emerge as a surf hotspot.

programme.title: No Contest: Off Tour

programme.title: S1E1 The Jackson Goldstone Story
programme.desc: Beyond Limits: The Jackson Goldstone Story is an electrifying YouTube series that follows mountain biking sensation Jackson Goldstone through his 2023 UCI Downhill World Championship season. Watch as he pushes his limits on some of the most dangerous downhill courses in the world, from steep, rocky descents to twisting forest trails, attacking every challenge with unmatched skill and determination. Go behind the scenes to see the intense training sessions, precise bike tuning, and mental preparation that fuel his success. Experience the rush of high-stakes racing with heart-pounding runs, fierce rivalries, and moments that will keep you holding your breath. More than just the action, Beyond Limits reveals Jackson’s personal journey, the sacrifices he makes for his passion, and the powerful support network that drives him forward. This is the ultimate inside look at a world-class athlete chasing glory on two wheels.

programme.title: S1E1 Animals
programme.desc: GoPro Animals delivers heartwarming, hilarious, and jaw-dropping moments from the animal world. From Golden Retrievers, French Bulldogs, and Border Collies bringing endless puppy smiles, to rescuing orcas and swimming with humpback whales, this show has it all. programme.title: S1E2 Moto

programme.title: S1E1 Tour
programme.desc: Pursuing the Tour de France, one of the most physically demanding sporting events in the world, covers over 3,535 kilometers in just three weeks. Every young cyclist dreams of competing in this prestigious race, but only nine riders from each team make the cut. Young cyclist Adam Yates is giving everything he has to prove he belongs on cycling’s biggest stage. 2016 Tour de France winner Chris Froome reflects on the long and grueling journey to victory, while former professional cyclists and Tour de France veterans Jens Voigt, Christian Vande Velde, and Haimar Zubeldia reveal what it truly takes to compete at the highest level.

Then join Gee, Rachel, and Dan Atherton, enduro and downhill champions, as they ride together through heart-pounding terrain. Speed, skill, and adrenaline collide in every unforgettable moment.

programme.title: S2E1 Bike

Then head to Zion, Utah for Red Bull Rampage with Jaxson Riddle, big-air phenom, Reed Boggs, freeride master, Thomas Genon, slopestyle superstar, and Tom Van Steenbergen, trail blazing pro, as they push the limits of skill and courage on some of the planet’s most extreme terrain.

programme.title: S2E2 Bike

Adventure, speed, and skill collide in every breathtaking moment.

Then experience some of the best riders from around the globe as they conquer massive mountains, perform jaw-dropping tricks, and push the limits of skill and adrenaline in breathtaking terrain.

programme.title: S1E1 Skate
programme.desc: This episode features the inspiring story of founders Miguel and Isabel. Driven by the belief that kids should be free to just be kids, #GoProForACause partner SanSkate is making a real difference in their community. Their mission is to provide a safe space for children who enter the workforce at a young age, giving them a chance to set aside their struggles and enjoy skateboarding. The episode also showcases the very best of GoPro skateboarding, featuring incredible talent from Andrew Brophy, Sewa Kroetkov, Madars Apse, and more.

programme.title: S1E2 Skate
programme.desc: Watch the inspiring story of Mike Rogers, an all-around skateboarding star from Cocoa Beach, FL. A regular competitor at top events around the world, including the Vans Pro-Tec Pool Party, Vans Bowl-A-Rama at Bondi Beach, and the Clash at Clairemont, Mike showcases his skill, style, and dedication to the sport. The episode also features Leticia Bufoni and Cata Diaz as she shares her perspective on women in skateboarding and explains why MACBA in Barcelona has become a world-renowned destination for skaters, with its iconic plaza, unique architecture, and perfectly smooth concrete.

programme.title: S1E3 Skate
programme.desc: Experience the very best of GoPro skateboarding at MACBA, Barcelona, celebrated worldwide as the ultimate Spanish skateboarding mecca. Don’t miss this unforgettable collaboration with #MacbaLife.

programme.title: S1E1 Two Roads
programme.desc:
“Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today.
This episode features Olympic bronze medalist Kristian Ipsen, American rugby union star Carlin Isles — celebrated as “The Fastest Man in Rugby” — and his remarkable rise from track and field and American football to becoming a two-time Olympian in rugby sevens. You’ll also meet Allison Stokke, a record-breaking high school pole vaulter who went on to compete at UC Berkeley, and Miles Chamley-Watson, a British-American fencing champion whose career includes 13 team Pan American titles, a 2019 team world championship, a 2013 individual world championship, three Olympic appearances, and a 2016 team Olympic bronze medal.

programme.title: S1E2 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Trenten Merrill, an American Paralympic long jumper who claimed bronze at the 2020 Summer Paralympics. Also featured is Casey Patterson, a powerhouse in professional beach volleyball with numerous AVP tournament wins, a gold medal on the FIVB World Tour, and an appearance at the 2016 Rio Olympics alongside Jake Gibb. Tennis legends Bob and Mike Bryan, the most successful doubles team in history, take the spotlight with 16 Grand Slam titles, 119 ATP Tour doubles victories, 438 weeks as the world’s No. 1 team, and Olympic gold in 2012. Rounding out the episode is acclaimed gymnastics coach Liang Chow, celebrated for guiding Gabby Douglas to the 2012 Olympic all-around gold and coaching Shawn Johnson to multiple medals at the 2008 Olympics.

programme.title: S1E3 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Paul Rabil, legendary professional lacrosse player and co-founder of the Premier Lacrosse League, celebrated as one of the greatest in the sport’s history. Also featured is Britney Henry, a standout track and field athlete from the University of Oregon who captured the Pac-10 Conference title in the hammer throw. Rounding out the episode is Meagan Martin, trailblazing competitor as the first female rookie to complete the American Ninja Warrior course and the first-ever Women’s Champion of the series.

programme.title: S1E1 Draft Story
programme.desc: In Part 1, we uncover the story of Tyvis Powell and the people who shaped him into the man and football player he is today. His road to the NFL was anything but easy, and it nearly never happened without the guidance of his mentor, Sean Williams. A Draft Story is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he makes the leap to professional football. Though he was not invited to Chicago for the 2016 NFL Draft, his journey is unforgettable. Witness the tension, hope, and emotion as Tyvis waits for the call that will change his life and etch the Powell name into NFL history. This is his Draft Story.

programme.title: S1 E2 Draft Story
programme.desc: A Draft Story” Part 2 is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he takes the leap into professional football. Facing unexpected challenges, honoring a promise to local kids, and navigating a situation he never imagined, Tyvis proves that the journey to the NFL is full of twists, heart, and determination.

programme.title: S1E1 Tour
programme.desc: Pursuing the Tour de France, one of the most physically demanding sporting events in the world, covers over 3,535 kilometers in just three weeks. Every young cyclist dreams of competing in this prestigious race, but only nine riders from each team make the cut. Young cyclist Adam Yates is giving everything he has to prove he belongs on cycling’s biggest stage. 2016 Tour de France winner Chris Froome reflects on the long and grueling journey to victory, while former professional cyclists and Tour de France veterans Jens Voigt, Christian Vande Velde, and Haimar Zubeldia reveal what it truly takes to compete at the highest level.

programme.title: S1E1 The Jackson Goldstone Story
programme.desc: Beyond Limits: The Jackson Goldstone Story is an electrifying YouTube series that follows mountain biking sensation Jackson Goldstone through his 2023 UCI Downhill World Championship season. Watch as he pushes his limits on some of the most dangerous downhill courses in the world, from steep, rocky descents to twisting forest trails, attacking every challenge with unmatched skill and determination. Go behind the scenes to see the intense training sessions, precise bike tuning, and mental preparation that fuel his success. Experience the rush of high-stakes racing with heart-pounding runs, fierce rivalries, and moments that will keep you holding your breath. More than just the action, Beyond Limits reveals Jackson’s personal journey, the sacrifices he makes for his passion, and the powerful support network that drives him forward. This is the ultimate inside look at a world-class athlete chasing glory on two wheels.

programme.title: S1E1 Moto
programme.desc: Two brothers. Two motorcycles. Ride along with GoPro Family members Carlos and Alex Costa on the adventure of a lifetime as they explore the vibrant cities and stunning beaches of Morocco. Plus, enjoy exclusive bonus footage featuring the very best of GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S1E2 Moto
programme.desc: The journey continues as we follow two brothers on their 2,300-kilometer adventure across Morocco. Two brothers. Two motorcycles. Ride along with GoPro Family members Carlos and Alex Costa as they experience vibrant cities, breathtaking beaches, and the adventure of a lifetime. Plus, enjoy bonus footage of Jeremy Seewer. With 50 podiums, 11 victories, 17 race wins, and five FIM Motocross World Championship silver medals, his record is remarkable — yet his story goes far beyond the numbers.

programme.title: S2E1 Moto
programme.desc: Celebrate the women of GoPro, including British rally driver Catie Munnings, who rose to fame after winning the FIA European Rally Championship Ladies Trophy at just 18. Watch snowboarder Alina Hight who made history as the first to land a double backside alley-oop rodeo in a halfpipe competition. Meet Teigan Nash, co-founder of Girls Who Glow, inspiring young women everywhere. Plus, experience even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S3E1 Moto
programme.desc: GoPro Athlete and Formula 1 star Daniel Ricciardo teams up with Race Service Co-Founder James Kirkham for an unforgettable ride through Los Angeles. With eight Grand Prix victories and 32 podiums to his name, the Honey Badger spends his day off behind the wheel of supercars like the Ford GT, racing past Beverly Hills, the Sunset Strip, and into the winding roads of Benedict Canyon. Plus, enjoy even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S1E1 El Nino
programme.desc: Chasing El Niño follows Chris Benchetler on an epic skiing adventure from California’s Mammoth Mountain and the Sierra Nevada backcountry to the vast slopes of British Columbia. Joined by longtime friends Bryan Fox, Scotty Smith, and Canadian pro skier Nick McNutt, Chris explores previously inaccessible terrain, searches for perfect powder, and faces challenging weather conditions. Along the way, the crew embraces the joy of skiing, building creative jumps at their campsite and making the most of every moment on the mountain. This episode captures the thrill of exploration, friendship, and the relentless pursuit of epic lines.

programme.title: S1E2 El Nino
programme.desc: Chris Benchetler continues his epic skiing adventure from California’s Mammoth Mountain and the Sierra Nevada backcountry to the massive slopes of British Columbia. This time, X Games gold medalist Jossi Wells joins him for "The Sierra Trifecta," tackling skiing, climbing, and biking all in a single day. Chris and his crew hike 6,000 vertical feet through rugged rock fields to chase the last snow of the season in the Sierras, pushing their limits and capturing every thrilling moment.
